### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | oncoanalyser output directory (one <group_id>/ sub-directory per tumor, plus pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (--input: group_id, subject_id, sample_id, sample_type, sequence_type, filetype, filepath). Defaults to input/samplesheet.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet id column. oncoanalyser fixes it to sample_id, the name every per-sample output file carries. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Samplesheet column the dashboard groups and filters samples by. Defaults to sample_class (sample_type and sequence_type joined, e.g. tumor_dna), which the sample hub derives. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |
| `GENOME` | — | Genome build of the run (UCSC name): hg38 for GRCh38_hmf, hg19 for GRCh37_hmf. Sets the chromosome ring, the locus views and their gene lane. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`cuppa/classifier_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cuppa/classifier_matrix.py) | CUPPA's probabilities as a cancer type by classifier matrix, for a heatmap. | `row_label`, `sample`, `cancer_type`, `combined` |
| [`cuppa/predictions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cuppa/predictions.py) | CUPPA's tissue-of-origin probabilities, one row per tumor, classifier and cancer type. | `sample`, `classifier_group`, `classifier`, `cancer_type`, `probability`, `rank`, `is_top` |
| [`hmf_bamtools/coverage_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hmf_bamtools/coverage_profile.py) | hmftools BamTools coverage distribution, as a cumulative curve per sample. | `sample`, `coverage`, `bases`, `fraction`, `fraction_at_least` |
| [`hmf_bamtools/fragment_length.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hmf_bamtools/fragment_length.py) | hmftools BamTools fragment length distribution, decimated for a profile. | `sample`, `fragment_length`, `pairs`, `fraction` |
| [`hmf_bamtools/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hmf_bamtools/summary.py) | hmftools BamTools alignment summary, one row per DNA sample. | `sample`, `region_bases`, `total_reads`, `duplicate_reads`, `dual_strand_reads`, `mean_coverage`, `sd_coverage`, `median_coverage`, `mad_coverage`, `low_map_qual_frac`, `duplicate_frac`, `unmapped_frac`, `low_base_qual_frac`, `overlapping_read_frac`, `capped_coverage_frac`, `frac_ge_10x`, `frac_ge_20x`, `frac_ge_30x`, `frac_ge_60x` |
